name: ES Overnight Session Profile
description: Overnight (globex) session market and volume profile for ES futures. Tracks POC, VAH, VAL, and VWAP across the 18:00-09:30 ET session using a 60-bar rolling volume profile. Visualizes key overnight levels on a time series chart, distribution of price vs POC, and session summary statistics.
source:
# ES Overnight Session Market & Volume Profile
# Tracks POC, VAH, VAL, VWAP during the 18:00-09:30 ET globex session
# Rolling 60-bar volume profile for stable level detection

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
volume = cont.v
ts = index().value

# --- Overnight Session Window (18:00 - 09:30 ET) ---
on_session = session_window(
    session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Volume Profile (60-bar rolling) ---
# Computes POC, VAH, VAL over a rolling 60-min window
vol_profile = price_profile(
    window_size=60,
    tick_size=0.25,
    value_area_pct=0.7,
    mode=ProfileType.volume
)(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

# --- Manual VWAP (session-anchored via cumulative reset) ---
# vwap() not available for futures — compute manually
typical_price = (cont.h + cont.l + cont.c) / 3
vwap_num = cumulative()(typical_price * cont.v, on_session.opened)
vwap_den = cumulative()(cont.v, on_session.opened)
manual_vwap = vwap_num.result / vwap_den.result

# --- Isolate overnight levels (only during overnight session) ---
on_poc = where(on_session.active, vol_profile.poc)
on_vah = where(on_session.active, vol_profile.vah)
on_val = where(on_session.active, vol_profile.val)
on_vwap = where(on_session.active, manual_vwap)
on_close = where(on_session.active, close)

# --- Price distance from POC (for distribution analysis) ---
# How far does price settle from the point of control?
poc_distance = where(on_session.active, close - vol_profile.poc)

# --- Value area width (VAH - VAL) as % of price ---
va_width_pct = where(on_session.active, (vol_profile.vah - vol_profile.val) / close)

# --- Chart 1: Overnight Price with Profile Levels ---
xy_lines(
    title='Where Is Overnight Fair Value?',
    y_axis_label='Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='POC', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAH', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VAL', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VWAP', color=Color.Cyan, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(on_close, on_poc, on_vah, on_val, on_vwap))

# --- Chart 2: Distribution of Price Distance from POC ---
# Answers: Does price cluster around POC or drift away?
histogram(
    title='How Far Does Price Drift from POC?',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Distance from POC (points)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='POC (zero)')
    ]),
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    order=2
)(poc_distance)

# --- Chart 3: Value Area Width Over Time ---
# Answers: Is the overnight session getting tighter or wider?
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Overnight Range Expanding or Contracting?',
    y_axis_label='Value Area Width (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_axis_label='',
    category='Overnight Profile',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VA Width %', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.002, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Tight (0.2%)')
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(va_width_pct,))

# --- Summary Table: Overnight Session Stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Overnight Session Profile Summary',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['POC Level', 'Value Area Width (pts)', 'VWAP Level'],
        col_headers=['Last', 'Median'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Overnight Profile',
    order=0
)(on_poc, on_poc, vol_profile.va_width, vol_profile.va_width, on_vwap, on_vwap)
